notes.title: Clash of Digital : Rumble Smash - Demo 2.0 final version updated
notes.content:
[h2]Demo 2.0 final version update : Character system recreated and bug fixed.[/h2]

Demo 2.0 final version is last demo version of this game, that mean it will be release for full version on next update.

Demo content :
4 local multiplayer battle with 4 character only. There are 4 playable character in the beginning. Ryu, Excel, Destiny and Antivi. 3 playable stage with normal mode only.
